page.overview:
Who is Nyubuna Bulul?

Nyubuna Bulul was a female Mon Calamari and the owner of The Even Cut Sabacc Parlor and Casino, in the Center Sphere District of Bartyn's Landing (Lamaredd) as of 29 BBY. Bulul had skill for business and was the direct competitor to Miss Mylla, with their businesses being neighbors to each other.
